 Ace Bailey scores 23 points in loss Tuesday 
 by Leo Sells | Jazz Correspondent | Wed, Nov 11th 2026, 12:10am EST 
 Ace Bailey scored 23 points (10-15 FG, 3-5 3PT) and grabbed seven rebounds in Tuesday's 115-109 loss to the Miami Heat. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Bailey played well on Tuesday, scoring 23 points on good shooting splits in a close loss to the Miami Heat. Fantasy managers should be well pleased with his fantasy output in this game, even if he's not likely to repeat it on a consistent basis moving forward.
